products.product_description: Lancaster LF Authentic Greek Salad Kit, 2/7.125lb. packages, net wt. 14.25lb., Item Code 407079, UPC 13454.38482. This is wholesale kit consisting of pre-packaged components in a corrugated box for assembly by retail delis. Kit contains sealed bags of cut produce (sliced cucumber, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, red onions), grape tomatoes, whole Kalamata olives, Feta cheese, and Greek Vinaigrette dressing.
products.reason_for_recall: Salmonella. Greek Salad Kit made with recalled cucumbers sourced from Bedner Grower's Company which may be contaminated with Salmonella and implicated in an ongoing outbreak.
